entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider acts as a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It offers temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval via an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and provides connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading. It is an AGPL-3.0 open-source context database designed to improve task-completion rates.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for the Hermes Agent provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It supports local deployment using PGLite and creates typed edges for a self-wiring knowledge graph.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system focuses on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports Docker-based deployment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library enables the construction of stateful agents through peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is the upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted wrapper and is available as a managed service or self-hosted FastAPI server.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and provides a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system combines vector search and structured facts to manage persistent memory on Qdrant. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite infrastructure.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving context harness provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets to assist agents with complex tasks. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine and a SQLite message store with FTS metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes to ensure no message is lost during context management.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This project provides a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open engram YAML format. It supports MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor while offering local-first, zero-cost search.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This layer provides local-first identity, memory, and secrets to enable portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and various MCP clients. It includes tools for memory inspection, editing, and deletion and reports a 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine uses hybrid retrieval with BM25 and vector search to function without cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and plugins, utilizing a local GGUF observer model to capture decisions.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool accelerates long context LLM inference through context optimization techniques like block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to reduce prefill latency and token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This is a durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, and a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It tracks contradictions through conflict and resolution primitives and supports both embedded in-process mode and HTTP backends.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp and functions as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide purpose-built evidence packets to the agent.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags for bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory system stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens before the context window opens. It implements the Model Context Protocol and supports local-first, encrypted persistent memory via the Perseus Vault.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable, cross-session memory storage for Hermes Agent. It enables semantic search and provides tools for updating state and maintaining continuity across different agents for user-approved memories.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server facilitates payments for APIs and AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to enable self-charging API capabilities.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, MCP servers, and skills.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This local plugin provides semantic and literal code search for private repositories. It supports grounded Q&A that includes specific file-and-line citations.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It also includes MinHash for near-duplicate detection and supports metadata or range filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It is essential for agents requiring a structured design refinement and brainstorming phase.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports while offering CLI support for coding agents. It integrates automation, design systems, and plugins to facilitate design workflows.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 production-grade skills across 29 security domains, mapped to six major cybersecurity and AI frameworks. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to generate diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using Rewrite, Detect, and Edit modes. It is compatible with Hermes and supports various voice profiles ranging from professional to blunt.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals through escrow and dispute resolution. It includes a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional agent skills in plain markdown format that run natively in Hermes Agent. It features integrations for Slack, Raycast, Obsidian, and n8n.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This library provides skills for video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project offers type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using modular packages. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables the agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It provides pre-built analytical lenses and reports findings alongside a summary of analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It incorporates a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models to manage project complexity.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running agents through a three-level work model and structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This skill set provides standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, error handling, and JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from repositories or documentation URLs. It ensures provenance through the use of file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification via a Python client and CLI. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes TON-based commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. It features built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This client uses a three-layer progressive loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This Rust-based engine implements 'Intent as Code' to provide a workflow language for AI. It features static auditing via nika check and produces hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system uses a five-layer approach including hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and provides graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces such as CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to model family and reasoning capability while preserving non-English prompts via langid or Unicode-range heuristics.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial bug-hunting by using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It features a deterministic pre-scan layer with Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec, and uses an MCP server to generate suppression rules.

entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and includes a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.

entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with Hermes Agent and agentskills.io standards.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates structured Chinese news reports across multiple geographic scales, from global to street level. It provides core conclusions and action suggestions and integrates user interests via semantic memory for search expansion.

entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing using NVIDIA OpenShell. It allows for kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.

entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces from a single web application. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized LLM agents for market analysis, including roles for fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis. It is designed for research purposes within the financial trading domain.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration platform supports workflows for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other agents via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture facilitates scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation and handoffs. It features bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a single screen. It includes a Kanban board for task status tracking and live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local communication and tool handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This framework coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies to compete for GitHub stars. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for fully-local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This Rust-powered kernel provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and features automatic project synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This cross-platform CLI tool features a native Rust TUI for tracking token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, and Gemini. It serves as a centralized monitoring solution for various LLM interfaces.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This tool acts as a local trace viewer for inspecting API traffic and agent context from Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It allows users to compare adjacent requests and export local traces into self-contained HTML viewers.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Claude.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, cost, and rate limits, including historical usage trends and multi-device synchronization. It reads Hermes Agent state directly alongside other CLIs and is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating applications with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This tool provides community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configurations.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents through encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes integrated session management and a research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup provides preconfigured skills and token-saving CLI workflows to achieve 90-99% token savings using RTK and Caveman templating. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills and offers automated installation for Linux and macOS.

entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter evaluates AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It operates without model or API calls by utilizing static regex and structural heuristics across multiple file formats.

entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides automated health monitoring and self-healing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It features a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for API requests and tool calls, alongside token intelligence tracking.

entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit designed for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It offers live per-session quota burn-rate tracking and operates locally with no telemetry or remote logging.

entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative TUI and dashboard allows users to chat with and manage Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop version of Hermes Agent that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides a self-hosted chat experience with real-time log streaming. It integrates a file browser and a dashboard for tracking tasks, skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
